posts.author: BobH
posts.content_md:
The only application of holograms in medicine I know of is as security stickers to protect the profits of the drug manufacturers. Hologram optical elements have been used in medical devices, and probably in medical research.

There is also no use for holograms in education, except maybe for a demonstration of modern optics.
